notes: RBox revision of the topic's transitive relation (RBOX_PER_TOPIC: transitivity). The edit states the property positively ('intransitive') so that the negation and the two compound questions carry no double negative: the earlier 'not transitive' wording made 3 of 4 models miss 'Is it false that ... is not transitive?', and its direct question ('non-transitive, so that ...') was missed by 3 of 4. Both readings of 'intransitive' (merely not transitive, or ruling the conclusion out) give the same answers here, since every question asks whether the conclusion follows; the axiom records the weaker one. Instances are chosen so that the conclusion is not a stored sentence that could compete with the edited property: 'tapetum is part of the stamen' and 'crista ampullaris is part of the inner ear' have 0 and 2 exact hits in Dolma, against the old left-ventricle and nephron instances whose conclusions are familiar anatomy (reviewer flags). Cross-lingual queries ask the first instance. Yes/no balance across the topic's six RBox revision records: this record's direct and instance answers are all 'no' after the edit; others carry the 'yes' side. Near unrelated asks the same property of another biology relation ('is descended from', still transitive: a leak turns yes to no); far asks a different property of an unrelated relation. hops counts the instance facts in the prompt as the bridge (1 + 1), as the template does.
